# tools: try warp and powerlevel10k

Try two changes to the terminal experience: [Warp](https://www.warp.dev), the Rust-based terminal with an IDE-like input editor, blocks and AI features, and [powerlevel10k](https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k), the fast, configurable zsh prompt theme (the [video](https://youtu.be/dIV9Cso4Mi8) walks through its install). **Motivation:** "boost my developer experience."
